test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In February 2022, which state/union territory police launched two women's squads to ensure safety and security of women in its capital city?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jammu and Kashmir.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Jammu and Kashmir Police recently started **Two women's safety squads in Srinagar city**.
 
• Each squad will comprise **5 Lady Police officers** or personnel.
 
• Both squads will be headed by **Inspector Khalida Parveen**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The women's safety squad was started to **help women in distress**.
 
• Its main purpose is to ensure the security of girls, especially across schools, colleges, universities, coaching centres, and other such places.
 
• They would be patrolling all across the city including educational institutions, during the day.
 
• Heads of the Institutions have also been asked to contact the women's squad in case, any incident takes place outside their centres.
